title: Pyramid Flow: High-Resolution Video Generation For Open-source
authors: Yang Jin, Zhicheng Sun, Ningyuan Li, Kun Xu, Kun Xu, Hao Jiang, Nan Zhuang, Quzhe Huang, Yang Song, Yadong Mu, Zhouchen Lin
summary: This paper introduces Pyramid Flow, an open-source approach for high-resolution video generation. It employs a flow matching framework with a pyramid-structured temporal modeling strategy that progressively generates video frames in a coarse-to-fine manner, significantly reducing computation for long video synthesis while maintaining temporal consistency.
AI_summary: 提出金字塔式时序建模的流匹配视频生成框架，由粗到细分段生成高分辨率长视频，在开源模型中实现较好的质量/成本平衡。
AI_keywords: 视频生成, 流匹配, 金字塔结构, 开源
AI_tldr: 用「先低分辨率再逐级细化」的流匹配思路，把高分辨率长视频生成的计算量降下来。

title: Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers for High-Resolution Image Synthesis
authors: Patrick Esser, Sumith Kulal, Andreas Blattmann, Rahim Entezari, Jonas Müller, Harry Saini, Yam Levi, Dominik Lorenz, Axel Sauer, Frederic Boesel, Dustin Podell, Tim Dockhorn, Zion English, Kyle Lacey, Alex Goodwin, Yannik Marek, Robin Rombach
summary: This paper studies the scaling behavior of rectified flow transformers for high-resolution image synthesis. We introduce improvements in noise sampling and architecture, including a shifted noise schedule and a two-stage training strategy, and show that transformer-based rectified flow models scale predictably with model size and data, achieving state-of-the-art text-to-image generation quality.
AI_summary: 系统研究 rectified flow Transformer 的规模律，通过噪声调度与两阶段训练改进，实现可预测扩展的高质量文生图（SD3 技术报告）。
AI_keywords: rectified flow, 扩散 Transformer, 规模律, 文生图
AI_tldr: 把「流匹配 + Transformer + 规模律」讲成一个可预测地变强的文生图配方。

title: Latte: Latent Diffusion Transformer for Video Generation
authors: Xin Ma, Yaohui Wang, Gengyun Jia, Xinyuan Chen, Ziwei Liu, Yuan-Fang Li, Cunjian Chen, Yu Qiao
summary: We propose Latte, a novel latent diffusion transformer for video generation. Latte first extracts spatial-temporal tokens from video clips using a pre-trained variational autoencoder, and then applies a series of transformer blocks to model the distribution of these tokens. We explore several efficient variants of spatial-temporal attention and demonstrate strong results on benchmark video generation datasets.
AI_summary: Latte：先用 VAE 抽取时空 token，再用 Transformer 建模分布，系统比较多种时空注意力变体的视频生成效果。
AI_keywords: 视频生成, 潜空间扩散, Transformer, 时空注意力
AI_tldr: 把视频切成立体 token，用 Transformer 直接学它们的扩散分布。
